work.start.prompt: What would you like to work on?
work.start.tree.driverNote: as the repository's own setting says
work.start.tree.checkoutNote: your checkout, on the branch it is on
work.start.tree.ownNote: a fresh tree beside the checkout
work.start.ownTreeCost: Its own tree holds only what git tracks, and the dependencies npm installed in your checkout, copied in where the tree's lockfile matches: no build outputs, no other installs, no untracked local configuration. That cost is paid once per tree, by whatever the rest of this repository's own setup costs.
work.start.busy: {{repository}} has an active session in its checkout. A working tree of its own lets this one start beside it.
work.start.task: Make it a task with Daoris…
work.start.none: No repository on this machine has a checkout to talk in yet.
work.start.browser: Open Daoris on this machine to start a conversation.
